# The Polished Pearl Nail Studio

> Russian manicure & nail art studio based in Pflugerville, Texas. A cozy one-artist studio in Pflugerville for Russian dry manicures, dry pedicures and custom nail art. Stef (Estefania) takes her time, cares for your skin as much as the polish, and keeps the snacks and the playlist going.

- Phone: (262) 258-8430
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Austin
- Google rating: 5.0 from 20 reviews

## Services
- Russian dry manicure: Precision e-file cuticle work and detailed nail prep, finished with a solid gel color laid right up to the cuticle line.
- Polished Pearl artist set: A full Russian dry manicure plus a custom design from Stef, based on her weekly and monthly inspiration sets on Instagram.
- Dry pedicure: A precision dry pedicure with detailed cuticle work and foot care, with or without a solid gel color.
- Nail art, chrome & cat-eye: Hand-painted art in three tiers, from simple lines and dots to detailed full sets, plus chrome powder and magnetic cat-eye gel.
- French, four ways: Classic or modern French, a double-lined French, a soft ombré, or a barely-there milky whisper French.
- Extensions, repair & foot care: Japanese soft gel extensions, NanoFlex reconstruction and IBX strengthening for damaged or peeling nails, plus paramedical foot care.

## About
The Polished Pearl is a private nail suite in Suite 203, Room 4, on Central Commerce Drive in Pflugerville, run by Estefania, or Stef to her clients. She has been licensed since the end of 2022 and is CMP and e-file certified. It's one chair and one client at a time, so nothing is rushed. Russian dry manicures and dry pedicures are the specialty: precision e-file cuticle work, detailed prep and color that sits right at the cuticle line, with sterilized tools and a clean studio every time. Stef also does Japanese soft gel extensions, nail repair and paramedical foot care, and clients say their nails have stayed healthy and grown long. Her favourite part is the nail art, from soft feminine designs to detailed trendy sets. The space is cozy on purpose, with snacks, a great playlist and plenty of conversation. Plan on taking some time: bring your laptop or put on a movie. Clients drive in from all over, one of them all the way from San Antonio.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What is a Russian manicure?
  A: It's a dry manicure built around precision e-file cuticle work and detailed nail prep, so gel can be applied right up to the cuticle line. The result looks very clean and grows out gracefully. It takes longer than a regular manicure, and it's worth it.
- Q: How much does it cost?
  A: A Russian dry manicure with gel color is $115 (about 2 hrs 30 min), or $100 with no polish. A dry pedicure with gel color is $130. A Polished Pearl artist set, a Russian manicure plus custom art, is $160. The full menu is on the Services page.
- Q: Is it okay if it's my first Russian manicure?
  A: Absolutely. Many of our reviews are from first-timers. Stef walks you through every step and answers all your questions.
- Q: How long should I plan for?
  A: Plan on taking some time, since this is detailed work: about 2 to 3 and a half hours depending on the service. Clients bring a laptop to get work done or watch a movie while Stef works.
- Q: Can you help with damaged or peeling nails?
  A: Yes. Stef offers NanoFlex reconstruction for damaged or missing nail areas, IBX strengthening for peeling nails, toe nail brace application and paramedical foot care (consultation recommended first).
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on The Polished Pearl's Square page and pick any open time, or call or text (262) 258-8430.
- Q: What should I know before booking?
  A: The Polished Pearl is by appointment only, and a card on file secures your spot. Please cancel or reschedule at least 12 hours ahead; same-day cancellations and changes with less than 12 hours' notice are charged 50% of the service. Arrive about 10 minutes early, since late arrivals may mean a shortened service.
- Q: Where is the studio and when is it open?
  A: Suite 203, Room 4, 15901 Central Commerce Dr, Pflugerville, TX 78660. It's a private nail suite, so please come alone unless you've arranged it with Stef ahead of time. Open Monday to Saturday 10 am to 8 pm, closed Sunday.
